summary.en: GLIN Impact Capital, established Feb 2021 in Minato, Tokyo by co-representatives Masato Nakamura and Masahiro Hata, calls itself Japan's first-generation impact/ESG VC. Its first fund targeted ¥1.0B for mid/late-stage startups in Japan and the US solving social issues. It has received a GOLD rating from third-party impact verifier BlueMark for two consecutive years. A larger 2nd impact-growth fund (max ¥30B) was announced in 2026.
summary.local: GLIN Impact Capitalは2021年2月設立（東京都港区南青山）、共同代表 中村将人・秦雅弘。日本第一世代のインパクト/ESG VCを自称。1号ファンドは目標10億円で日米の中〜後期成長企業に投資。第三者検証機関BlueMarkより2年連続GOLD評価を獲得。2026年に最大300億円の2号インパクト・グロースファンドを発表。

strategy.thesis: Founding-stage (創業期) specialized fund supporting diverse entrepreneurs including women founders, motivated by the fact that women remain under 20% of investors in Japan even as female entrepreneurs grow.

summary.en: Oikaze Ventures (Minato, Tokyo) was founded in 2026 by Misuzu Matsumoto, a female capitalist who left Incubate Fund. strategy.thesis: Equity-free cash award program for women-founded startups across Japan, South Korea and India that drive innovation and solve social challenges through responsible use of AI, paired with Google mentorship, Cloud credits and product support.

application_cycles: Annual; first APAC cohort recruited Aug 2023

summary.en: Google for Startups Women Founders Fund is an equity-free grant program (launched Aug 2023) for women-founded startups in Japan, South Korea and India using AI to solve social challenges. Each selected company receives US$100,000 plus Google mentorship, Cloud credits and product support; the APAC cohort included ~6-7 companies, with Japanese selectees including Yuimedi.
